free_design.Place: an empty planetarium visitors gallery beside a large brass star globe, soft amber aisle lights and a blue domed ceiling
free_design.Activity: she pauses after an astronomy demonstration to retrieve a paper star that has landed on the padded visitor seat, an unexpectedly gentle pastime for a fearless vanguard
free_design.Pose: standing with her weight balanced, she holds one plain paper star in her right hand at chest height; her left hand rests flat on the seat back, each arm visibly connected to its own shoulder
free_design.Framing: a three-quarter frontal view from head to mid-thigh, camera at chest height and both hands in view
free_design.Outfit: an original adult planetarium-guide event costume: a copper-orange structured halter crop bodice with opaque full bust coverage, a short high-waisted violet envelope skirt over fitted opaque shorts, and a silver-edged shoulder capelet; as she reaches forward the capelet catches harmlessly over the seat corner and lifts away to reveal her bare shoulder and side waist; no real insignia or lettering
